arguments.prompt: Low angle from the paving. Two workmen in high-visibility vests and knit caps steadily raise a tall square pine upright from a lean to full vertical, hand over hand, their breath steaming in the cold; a third man holds a diagonal brace steady. The camera is locked off on a tripod and does not move at all: no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no drift, no handheld shake. Real-time speed, natural human movement, never slow motion. Behind them the semicircular colonnade of City Hall with its mauve banner stays perfectly fixed; the parked cars, the lumber flatbed and the box van do not move; two distant pedestrians walk slowly away from the camera. Effortful, deliberate, real-time movement, faces turned toward the post, never toward the camera. Low winter sun. Prestige political drama photographed on an Arri Alexa with anamorphic lenses: single-source natural light, slight 35mm film grain, colours desaturated about twelve percent, warm tungstens, deep browns and charcoals in the shadows, photographic realism.
